messages:
taylor: Heads-up — PR #3128 has a few formatting/lint fixes but CI is blocked on a couple of failures. Can someone from infra/platform own a quick pass so we can merge before tomorrow's deploy? Diff is tiny (varnames + linewraps). @lee @morgan

lee: I can take a look in ~30m. Which CI job is failing?

taylor: The `linters` job. flake8 shows F401 (unused import) and E501 (line too long) in eng/runtime/kv_cache.py. Screenshot in the PR.

morgan: Started a local run — looks like one leftover import (`typing.Optional`) and an f-string that exceeds 120 chars. I can push a micro-fix if that's alright. Pinging @alex for the varname rename approval.

alex: Fine to rename. prefer `cache_key` over `k` for clarity. Add a one-line comment about the eviction heuristic. Small changes only.

dev-bot: CI rerun queued for branch taylor/pr-3128 (build 879).

sam: Quick FYI — please don't bypass hooks. Run:
```
pre-commit run -a
pytest -q
git push origin HEAD
```
If pre-commit still fails, post the lint output here and we can iterate.

morgan: Pushed fix (commit 5f3a1c9). Changes: removed unused import, renamed `k` -> `cache_key`, wrapped long f-string into two parts, added comment. Ran pre-commit and unit tests locally.

dev-bot: CI build 879 started.

dev-bot: CI build 879: all checks passed :tada:

maria: LGTM on docs and examples. Nice catch on the f-string wrap.

taylor: Thanks everyone — merging now. Will monitor prod deploy. :rocket: 

lee: Thanks for owning the quick follow-up, @morgan. Heads-up: I'll pick up a small follow-on that tightens a type annotation in the same file tomorrow morning.

taylor: Great, noted. Closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:
